title: CARD: Classification and Regression Diffusion Models

passages.short_quote: Replace the continuous response variable with a one-hot encoded label vector
passages.interpretation: Existing discriminative generative modeling uses labels as continuous response targets.

passages.short_quote: treats each one-hot label as a class prototype
passages.interpretation: A class-code flow is not a new source of supervision by itself.

passages.paraphrase: Inference begins from a Gaussian centered on the learned predictor and iterates denoising conditioned on x and predictor output; the unknown true label is not provided. A separate classification decoder maps the reconstructed real vector to class scores.

passages.short_quote: we set the number of timesteps as T = 1000
passages.interpretation: The paper does not justify a four-step graph flow solver or a cost-free transfer.

passages.interpretation: Another sampled target velocity is available without another model forward; inference still has its generative solver.
